title: Migrate root game export containers from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the root export container types in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `GameExport` and `BuiltGameExport`. Fold `_GameExportBase`, `_OptionalGameExportFields`, and `_AnnotatedGameExportFields` into this migration instead of splitting them into separate issues.

This should be the last migration in the series because it touches the validated loader boundary and a wide set of downstream consumers. Preserve the existing schema version and JSON interchange behavior while moving the in-memory representation to dataclasses.

Keep the PR centered on the root container conversion, loader/serializer updates, and the broad test updates needed to keep the export pipeline stable.
